clue.text: Stand and deliver? Not if I'm around

definitions.text: Stand and deliver? Not if I'm around

parts.words: Stand and deliver? Not if I'm around
parts.note: read 'stand' as a piece of furniture on which a mother delivers a baby; the punchline says that while this seat is around, nobody is standing to give birth

explanation.surface: A highwayman's cry of 'Stand and deliver!' met by a defiant would-be victim.
explanation.walkthrough: The highwayman's demand is the false trail; 'deliver' means give birth and 'stand' is the support used for it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a special seat designed for women to sit upright on during labour and delivery.

clue.text: Support piece of research, one concerned with a form of screening

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
a project is a piece of research
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means about, concerned with

explanation.surface: Backing a research piece by someone interested in a type of screening.
explanation.walkthrough: Back projection is a cinema technique where a film is projected from behind onto a translucent screen.
explanation.definitionFit: This film technique throws an image from behind onto a screen, so it is one way of screening pictures.

clue.text: Disturb game bird, blowing its head off

indicators.note: losing its head means the bird's first letter is removed

parts.note: the grouse is a game bird shot for sport

explanation.surface: A shooter scares up a game bird and blasts it.
explanation.definitionFit: To rouse someone is to wake or disturb them.

clue.text: The briefest of sleeps at noon or six

parts.note: a doze is a short sleep, and half of one is briefer still

explanation.surface: A tiny catnap taken at midday or at six o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A dozen is twelve, so half that number is six.

clue.text: Covers up cooking utensil and dishes

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the utensil's word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a pan is a cooking utensil
pies are dishes

explanation.surface: A kitchen scene where pans and dishes are covered over.
explanation.definitionFit: Nappies are the absorbent pads that cover a baby's bottom, so they are coverings in a sense.

clue.text: Completely stun prisoner taking oath

parts.note: a con is a convict, a prisoner
a cuss is a swear word, an oath

explanation.surface: A prisoner swearing so violently it stuns everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: To concuss is to knock someone senseless by a blow, stunning them entirely.

clue.text: Horse in great pain

indicators.note: in places the drug's letter within the word for great

parts.note: ace means excellent, great
horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.surface: A horse suffering a great deal of pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horse' looks literal but is slang for heroin, whose abbreviation is H.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull continuous pain.

clue.text: Downfall of one country following sport

indicators.note: following puts the sport's letters before the rest

parts.note: RU stands for rugby union, a sport
I is the Roman numeral for one
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A country collapses after an obsession with sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruination is ruin or destruction, a downfall.

clue.text: In town, man meets lad shiftily concealing drug

parts.note: he is a pronoun for a man

indicators.note: concealing means the drug sits inside the rearranged letters
shiftily suggests the letters of the two words moving about

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
hemp is cannabis, a drug

explanation.surface: In some town a man encounters a shifty youth hiding narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shiftily' rearranges the two words into MELSTEAD, and 'concealing' puts the drug inside it. Hemel Hempstead is a town in Hertfordshire, north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemel Hempstead is a new town in Hertfordshire, England.

clue.text: Mean-spirited type revealed companion's web address

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order
a URL is a web address

explanation.surface: An online friend's link exposes them as a nasty person.
explanation.walkthrough: The Companion of Honour is a British honour, abbreviated CH.
explanation.definitionFit: A churl is a rude, ill-bred, ungenerous person.

clue.text: This should make you laugh, end of story

definitions.meaning: the climactic line of a joke that provokes laughter
the final line that wraps up a tale or joke

explanation.surface: A comedian promising a laugh at the end of the tale.
explanation.definitionFit: The closing line of a joke is meant to get the laugh and ends the story.

clue.text: When drunk, a croupier's having difficulty remaining upright

indicators.note: being drunk means the letters stagger into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the S included

explanation.surface: A tipsy casino croupier wobbling on their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Something precarious is unsteady and liable to fall.

clue.text: Food in parts of Asia?

definitions.meaning: ... means food, as in good plain ...
read cryptically as ...., the Far East shortened, with the question mark flagging the wordplay

explanation.surface: Asking what cuisine is eaten in parts of Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the answer as FAR E, short for Far East, the eastern parts of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Fare is the food and drink provided, as on a menu.

clue.text: Struggle to grasp alien reputations in oriental language

indicators.note: grasping means the word for struggle wraps around the next pieces

parts.note: to vie is to compete or struggle
ET is the film's extraterrestrial, an alien
names are reputations, as in making a name

explanation.surface: Fighting to understand foreigners' reputations in an Eastern tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for struggle is split around the two inner pieces, its last letter landing at the very end.
explanation.definitionFit: Vietnamese is the language of Vietnam in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Old ruler useless, quite a burden if so

parts.note: Nero was a Roman emperor, a ruler
US is short for unserviceable, useless

explanation.surface: An old monarch who is no good is a real burden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if so' points back to the old ruler being useless; such a ruler would be burdensome.
explanation.definitionFit: Onerous means heavy and burdensome to bear.

clue.text: What did you say about increased prices current in the Middle East?

indicators.note: about means the query wraps around the next word

parts.note: eh? is what one says when asking for a repeat
up means increased, as prices are up
rates are prices or charges

explanation.surface: Asking someone to repeat what they said about rising prices in the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: The Euphrates is a great river of the Middle East, and a river is a current of water.

clue.text: Like a cad wearing smart clothes

indicators.note: clothes is a verb here, the smart word dressing around the other

parts.note: swish means smart or fashionable
in means wearing, as in in a suit

explanation.surface: A rotter dressed in fashionable clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' looks like a noun but is the verb: the smart word dresses around the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Swinish means coarse and contemptible, the way a cad behaves.

clue.text: Train journalists no longer

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
the press is journalists collectively

explanation.surface: A train carrying reporters who have retired.
explanation.definitionFit: An express is a fast train making few stops.

clue.text: Could it help Jack get moderate grade in oral?

indicators.note: in oral means the phrase is spoken, so its sound counts

parts.note: a C mark is a middling grade in an exam

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a student called Jack would scrape a C in his oral exam.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack is a sailor (jack tar); a seamark is a landmark guiding sailors. Said aloud, C mark sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A seamark is a conspicuous object guiding sailors, so it helps a jack tar navigate.

clue.text: In a word substitute spy chief has returned my message

parts.note: M is the head of the secret service in the James Bond stories

indicators.note: returned means the words for my and message are read backwards together

parts.note: taken as written
a note is a short message

explanation.surface: A substitute spy chief sends back a personal message.
explanation.definitionFit: A metonym is a word used in place of another closely associated one, such as crown for monarch.

clue.text: Sentimental woman invited into garden left home

parts.note: Tennyson's poem says 'Come into the garden, Maud'
in means at home

explanation.surface: A tearful woman invited into the garden leaves her house.
explanation.walkthrough: The garden invitation alludes to Tennyson's line 'Come into the garden, Maud'.
explanation.definitionFit: Maudlin means tearfully or foolishly sentimental.

clue.text: Sharp-tasting fruit in this dish

definitions.meaning: a pastry dish with fruit filling

explanation.surface: A sour fruit tart.
explanation.definitionFit: Tart means sour, and a tart is a pastry case filled with fruit.

clue.text: Note US state's supplying fuel

parts.note: a natural is a note neither sharp nor flat
GA is the postal abbreviation for Georgia, plus the apostrophe S

explanation.surface: A note says an American state is providing fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural gas is a fossil fuel used for heating and cooking.

clue.text: Good party organiser offers spirit

parts.note: a host organises a party

explanation.surface: A fine party host offers a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' suggests a drink, but it is a ghost.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghost is a spirit of the dead.

clue.text: Woman taken in by love rat

indicators.note: taken in by means the name sits inside the next words

explanation.surface: A woman deceived by an unfaithful lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Vera is a common female given name, so it stands for a woman by example.

clue.text: Where varnish is put without delay

definitions.meaning: nail varnish goes on a fingernail
immediately, as in paying cash promptly

explanation.surface: A manicurist applying polish straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying on the nail means paying at once, and varnish is literally applied to a nail.

clue.text: Show strong feelings, rejecting English literary work

indicators.note: rejecting means the word for a literary work is turned back

parts.note: a tome is a large book

explanation.surface: Someone getting emotional while rejecting a piece of English literature.
explanation.definitionFit: To emote is to display feelings theatrically.

clue.text: The drink's safe? Wrong, if it's this

definitions.text: The drink's safe? Wrong, if it's this

indicators.note: wrong signals that the letters are wrongly ordered

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the S included
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asking whether the sea is safe to swim in.
explanation.walkthrough: The drink is slang for the sea; it is not safe if full of sharks.
explanation.definitionFit: Shark-infested water is full of sharks and dangerous to swim in.
